2607.12527.title: Evidence-Grounded AI for Musculoskeletal Care
2607.12527.paper_summary: Musculoskeletal diseases are among the leading causes of disability worldwide and create the greatest global need for rehabilitation. Because recovery, remodelling and degeneration often unfold over months to years, musculoskeletal care requires longitudinal management that repeatedly integrates evolving patient evidence, external medical knowledge and stage-specific functional goals. In routine practice, this evidence is fragmented across visits, departments and hospital systems, limiting individualized, evidence-based care. Here we report OrthoPilot, a clinical artificial intelligence system powered by a large language model that integrates hospital data streams with authoritative external knowledge for continuous musculoskeletal management. OrthoPilot autonomously retrieves real-time imaging, laboratory, pathology and order data and converts evolving patient states into evidence-based decisions from admission diagnosis to rehabilitation planning. We established a specialist-validated benchmark from real-world electronic health records spanning 1,000 disease codes. In a reader study across the complete care pathway, OrthoPilot was compared with 81 orthopaedic physicians and surpassed experts with 25 years of experience in diagnostic reasoning, clinical decision-making and management planning. It also outperformed all evaluated intelligent systems across 60 external clinical centres. In a prospective study of 1,870 complex cases, OrthoPilot increased full-chain management success by 10.6%. During an 8-month randomised deployment involving 8,240 inpatients, it increased cumulative cases per bed by 9.7% and improved patient-reported access to health information. These results move clinical AI from predicting isolated events toward executing longitudinal management across complete musculoskeletal care pathways.
2607.12527.paper_summary_zh: 肌肉骨骼疾病是全球主要的殘疾原因之一，並造成最大的康復需求。因為康復、重塑和退化通常需要數月到數年的時間，肌肉骨骼護理需要長期管理，這需要不斷整合不斷變化的病人證據、外部醫療知識和特定階段的功能目標。在日常實踐中，這些證據在就診、部門和醫院系統之間是分散的，限制了個性化的基於證據的護理。我們在此報告 OrthoPilot，一個臨床人工智慧系統，利用大型語言模型將醫院數據流與權威的外部知識整合，以實現持續的肌肉骨骼管理。OrthoPilot 自動檢索實時影像、實驗室、病理和訂單數據，並將不斷變化的病人狀態轉換為基於證據的決策，從入院診斷到康復計劃。我們從涵蓋 1,000 種疾病代碼的實際電子健康記錄中建立了一個專家驗證的基準。在整個護理路徑的讀者研究中，OrthoPilot 與 81 位骨科醫生進行了比較，並超越了擁有 25 年經驗的專家在診斷推理、臨床決策和管理規劃方面的表現。它在 60 個外部臨床中心的所有評估智能系統中也表現優於其他系統。在一項涉及 1,870 例複雜病例的前瞻性研究中，OrthoPilot 將全鏈管理的成功率提高了 10.6%。在一項為期 8 個月的隨機部署中，涉及 8,240 名住院病人，它將每床累計病例數提高了 9.7%，並改善了病人報告的健康信息獲取。這些結果使臨床人工智慧從預測孤立事件轉向在完整的肌肉骨骼護理路徑中執行長期管理。
